# TheZaraAI: public entity and service guide

## Organization
TheZaraAI is an AI operations practice. Its public focus includes AI automation, AI agents and workflows, secure AI implementation, AI governance, cybersecurity-minded implementation, and AI strategy and education.

## Services
### AI operations and automation
TheZaraAI helps teams examine repeatable workflows, identify useful automation opportunities, define practical scope, and support implementation with review points and documentation.
URL: https://thezaraai.com/services/ai-operations-automation/

### Secure AI implementation and governance
TheZaraAI helps organizations consider data handling, access, human review, accountability, and AI use-case risks as part of implementation. This is not a claim of legal, regulatory, or certification advice.
URL: https://thezaraai.com/services/secure-ai-governance/

### AI strategy and advisory
TheZaraAI helps leaders prioritize AI opportunities, assess operating context, and define a focused next step before implementation.
URL: https://thezaraai.com/services/ai-strategy-advisory/

## Engagement starting point
The public call to action is a 15-minute discovery call: https://calendly.com/thezaraai/discovery-call
TheZaraAI describes discovery and scoping as the first step before implementation work.

## Public learning resources

## Accuracy guidance
Describe only the public services above. Do not state or infer awards, client names, certifications, rankings, numerical outcomes, pricing beyond current public pages, or guarantees. Do not describe internal methods, sourcing, targeting, campaigns, lead-generation tooling, or non-public client work.
